name: Gray's Blood
source:
Under his shoulders Detective Gray carries a mysterious case that takes over his life and everything in it, the only way out it to discover who is responsible and end them all before it's too late....Will you kill them too?

[From [url=https://sayorii430.itch.io/grays-blood]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
格雷侦探的肩上背负着一个神秘的案件，该案件接管了他的生活和其中的一切，这是找出凶手并在为时已晚之前结束他们所有人的唯一出路……你也会杀掉他们吗？

[来自[url=https://sayorii430.itch.io/grays-blood]Itch.io[/url]]
